Description: Umbrella after-sales programme: "a chain of vital after-sales services created to protect your investment in Hitachi construction machinery". Comprises Global e-Service, Technical Support, HELP (Hitachi Extended Life Program) and service contracts, and Hitachi Parts. Supplied via the European dealer network.
Applies To Machine Category: All categories (site does not differentiate by category)

Description: Dealers have "the tools, knowledge and resources to ensure that you get the best performance from your machine"; they offer technical expertise, extended warranty options and service contracts, preventative maintenance advice, and assistance with parts and components.
Dealers offer preventative maintenance advice. Remanufactured components are described as "a perfect choice for preventative maintenance".
Included in the Hitachi Extended Warranty: "regular services and inspections to increase availability".
Applies To Machine Category: Excavators, Wheel Loaders, Rigid Dump Trucks (per Full Coverage wording)

Description: Dealers "monitor the condition of your equipment, whether it’s online using our remote monitoring application (Global e-Service) or out in the field taking oil samples". Oil analysis is also listed in the Extended Warranty inclusions.
Extended Warranty includes "repairs using Hitachi Genuine Parts", with records of all maintenance and repairs kept so the machine value can be evaluated and potentially increased at resale.
Applies To Machine Category: Excavators, Wheel Loaders, Rigid Dump Trucks

Service Name: HELP - Hitachi Extended Life Program (extended warranty)
Description: Unique extended warranty for machines working in severe conditions or where the customer wants to minimise repair costs. Three options: Full Coverage, Power Train, or a combination of both.
Applies To Machine Category: Excavators, Wheel Loaders, Rigid Dump Trucks

Description: Extension of the standard warranty covering the same components for a maximum period of 84 months or 12,000 hours (whichever comes first). Suitable for extensively operated excavators, wheel loaders and dump trucks, such as those in demolition, mining and quarrying.
Applies To Machine Category: Excavators, Wheel Loaders, Rigid Dump Trucks

Description: Covers major components: hydraulic cylinders, main pumps, swing bearings, travel motors, swing motors and control valves. Starts when the standard warranty expires and runs a further 72 months or 10,000 hours. Ideal for excavators and wheel loaders in general construction projects.
Related Parts: Hydraulic cylinders; main pumps; swing bearings; travel motors; swing motors; control valves

Description: Comprehensive, tailor-made service contracts from the Hitachi dealer. The components covered by each option are not published; the site directs the customer to the local dealer.
Professional service technicians with full and regular technical training from HCME and access to all the latest technical information available in the Hitachi organisation.
"Only your authorised local Hitachi dealer has the diagnostic tools and product expertise to keep your machine in optimum condition." Specific diagnostic tool names/versions are not published.

Training for dealer service teams at the HCME Training and Demonstration Centre in Amsterdam, or closer to home at a dealer depot. Gives access to the same technical knowledge available to global Hitachi quality assurance departments and design centres.
Dealers "help to develop the skills of your operators by providing theory-based and practical training".

Service Name: Parts supply via European Parts Depot
Description: Parts ordered from a local dealer are dispatched from the 53,000 m2 HCME European Parts Depot in Oosterhout, The Netherlands within 24 hours. It houses up to 70,000 parts items and is one of only six such depots outside Japan.

The customer exchanges a used part for the corresponding remanufactured component at the local dealership. The core is returned to a dedicated Hitachi Reman centre, remanufactured to the same standards as new components, and supplied to another customer with a comprehensive warranty.
Applies To Machine Category: Excavators and Wheel Loaders (per page wording)

Description: A Hitachi dealer can configure a bucket tailored to the customer application, with a variety of selectable options.
Hitachi excavators and wheel loaders available to rent direct from HCME via the dealer network. Mid-size machines from 8 to 50 tonnes, hired by the month for periods up to one year.

Every model undergoes a rigorous inspection and refurbishment process when necessary, using only Hitachi Genuine parts and lubricants, according to Hitachi specifications. Machines selected are no more than five years old with a full maintenance history via Global e-Service.
Related Parts: Hitachi Genuine Parts; Hitachi Genuine lubricants

Description: Approved Hitachi warranty of 12 months or 1,500 hours when bought from an authorised dealer.

Service Name: Dealer network sales, service and parts
Description: Network of local dealers providing sales, delivery and maintenance, with expert training at HCME facilities in Amsterdam and continuous access to HCME sales, service and parts teams.

Leasing and financing for new and used Zaxis excavators and wheel loaders, delivered with partners BNP Paribas Leasing Solutions and DLL. Certain promotional offers bundle a 3-year extended warranty. Available in 15 named European countries.
Applies To Machine Category: Zaxis excavators and ZW wheel loaders
